# Line starts Chrome 154 chose, as character offsets, for each text below laid out in
# Geist Regular (examples/letter_spacing/fonts/Geist-Regular.ttf) at line-height 1.5.
# `<mode> <font-size px> <width px> <text index> <starts>`, mode being the CSS text-wrap.
# Measured with `--headless=new` from a page of absolutely positioned <div>s; single-line
# cases are left out.
text 0 A channel for this project
text 1 A new workspace chooses its own accounts and holds its own projects. You can add one later from Hive.
text 2 Answer in the same thread, then open in Slate
text 3 Answer Kora and open your brief
text 4 Answer Kora’s questions in the thread’s Reply box: share your topic, who you want to reach, and how often you want to publish. Send your reply and wait for the draft.
text 5 A project can have several channels, such as #planning and #first_issue.
text 6 A saved comment is feedback. Ask Kora applies that feedback in a new version, so you can always look back at what you had before.
text 7 Ask in plain words to prepare a command you can review.
text 8 Ask Kora to use your feedback
text 9 Associate the account that belongs in this workspace: a personal account for Personal, a work account for Work, or the account you use with a client. You can connect Google, Microsoft, or both.
text 10 Associate your Google or Microsoft account in workspace settings.
text 11 A topic is a channel outside a project. Use it for interests, everyday questions, or ideas that aren’t ready to become a project.
text 12 A topic outside the newsletter project
text 13 Bring the right account with you.
text 14 Browse apps and AI tools for what you want to do.
text 15 Browse local files and accessible remote destinations.
text 16 Browse your collection and discover games.
text 17 Browse your schedule and switch calendar views.
text 18 Calendar is also available as a tab inside Mail.
text 19 Check for available updates.
text 20 Choose Chord from the app list.
text 21 Choose Continue in Chord to return to your conversation. If the thread is closed, click its reply count in #planning to reopen it.
text 22 Choose General. Accounts and your workspace name live on this page.
text 23 Choose Hive from the app list.
text 24 Choose Kora Settings from this menu. You can always find it here.
text 25 Choose Local to manage your workspaces.
text 26 Choose Local. Your project channels and topics are here.
text 27 Choose + New project above the project list.
text 28 Choose Rename. This is the same workspace, with a name you chose.
text 29 Choose Rename workspace on this row.
text 30 Choose Slate from the app list.
text 31 Choose the accounts this workspace uses
text 32 Choose whether memory tracking is on in Memory’s Settings.
text 33 Choose Workspace Settings in the left sidebar.
text 34 Chord is where you talk through ideas, with people or with Kora. Project channels organize conversations around your goal; threads keep each discussion together.
text 35 Click Comment beside the selected words.
text 36 Click New workspace at the bottom of the sidebar.
text 37 Click the “1 comment” button at the top right of the document. Find your note and choose Ask Kora to address it. Wait for the revised draft.
text 38 Click the “1 comment” button at the top right of the document. Your note appears in the list. Choose Ask Kora to address it and wait for the revision.
text 39 Click the + beside Topics.
text 40 Click the + beside your newsletter project.
text 41 Click the highlighted app launcher in the desktop bar.
text 42 Click the highlighted Kora symbol in the desktop bar.
text 43 Comment on a passage, then Ask Kora to address the feedback.
text 44 Turn a personal idea into a project.
text 45 Organize the different parts of your life.
text 46 Memory isn't available right now. Kora keeps what it learns on this computer.
text 47 Choose what Kora can do on its own in this workspace, and what it asks you about first.
text 48 Your files stay on this device unless you share them.
text 49 Drag a file here or choose Browse to add it to the conversation.
text 50 No events this week
text 51 A short line
text 52 Supercalifragilisticexpialidocious words sometimes appear in otherwise ordinary sentences.
text 53 The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog while the cat watches from the windowsill.
text 54 Install apps, agents and models for this workspace, or for everyone on this computer.
text 55 Settings, files and conversations from a workspace never reach another workspace.
